projects.title: AI-Based Driver Assignment Optimization
projects.outcome: Cut rider wait times by up to 5x
projects.description: Developed an AI model to optimize driver-rider matching for a ride-hailing platform by analyzing driver behavior and trip data. Built with Python and TensorFlow on a dataset of 86K+ records to enhance assignment efficiency and user satisfaction.

projects.title: Forest Fire Detection and Monitoring System
projects.outcome: Real-time fire detection running autonomously on the edge
projects.description: An intelligent system for early detection and real-time monitoring of forest fires. Processes video streams from strategic camera placements to identify fire patterns and smoke signatures, alerting authorities immediately. Optimized for edge deployment on NVIDIA Jetson devices for autonomous operation in remote areas with limited connectivity.

projects.title: Equipment Inspections Platform
projects.outcome: Replaced paperwork with a digital inspection pipeline
projects.description: A web-based platform that streamlines the equipment inspection process for industrial safety companies: digital inspection forms, automated reporting, client dashboards, and maintenance scheduling with notifications. Reduced paperwork, improved inspection accuracy, and enhanced client communication in safety-critical environments.
